The overview is the level-1 crop with greatest display overlap, or level 0 if unavailable.

geometries.method: Representative point within the Copernicus southern Black Sea monitoring sector (31.5–35°E); not a surveyed current core or full path.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: Copernicus Marine defines this basin-scale cyclonic flow and measures intensity in northern and southern slope sectors. Those sectors are monitoring windows, not a full current centerline or length. Older Caucasus and Southern Current names may describe sectors, but equivalence is unresolved.
